message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: 'Linux'

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'master'
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, synchronize ]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency: 
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  Build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        # `OfflineTools` builds AssetPacker and ShaderCompiler as well. Neither of them ends up in the game
        # package and neither depends on the backend or the RHI, so it's enough to compile them once per
        # compiler (this entry and the clang one below) instead of in all six configurations. AssetPacker is
        # published as its own artifact, but only from this entry - see the packaging step below.
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: GLFW
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++
          OfflineTools: 'ON'

        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: GLFW
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++
          OfflineTools: 'ON'
          
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++

        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++

        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: Vulkan
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++

        # SDL3 backend (testing only for now). libsdl3-dev isn't in the ubuntu-22.04 repos, so this entry runs
        # on ubuntu-26.04 where it can be installed via apt (see the SDL3 dependency step below).
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL3
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++
          OS: ubuntu-26.04

    #runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.OS || 'ubuntu-22.04' }}

    steps:
    - name: 'Checkout Repository'
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Cache apt packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          /var/cache/apt/archives
          /var/lib/apt/lists
        key: apt-${{ matrix.OS || 'ubuntu-22.04' }}-v1
        restore-keys: |
          apt-${{ matrix.OS || 'ubuntu-22.04' }}-

    - name: 'Create Build Environment'
      run: |
        sudo apt update -y
        # `libdw-dev` (elfutils) is what makes the crash reports readable: without it Backward falls back to
        # `backtrace_symbols()`, which resolves addresses through the dynamic symbol table only - and since
        # everything is compiled with `-fvisibility=hidden`, that yields bare addresses and no function names.
        # It's also the only stack details backend that follows ".gnu_debuglink" into the split symbol file.
        sudo apt install -y cmake curl g++ libgl1-mesa-dev libopenmpt-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libdw-dev rpm

    - if: matrix.CC == 'clang'
      name: 'Configure Clang Compiler'
      uses: egor-tensin/setup-clang@v1
      with:
        version: 15

    - if: matrix.Backend == 'SDL3'
      name: 'Install SDL3'
      run: |
        # libsdl3-dev is available from the ubuntu-24.04 repositories (this entry runs on ubuntu-24.04).
        # libmpg123-dev is added so the linker can satisfy libopenmpt's transitive libmpg123 dependency.
        sudo apt install -y libsdl3-dev libmpg123-dev

    - name: 'Configure CMake'
      run: |
        export CC=${{ matrix.CC }}
        export CXX=${{ matrix.CXX }}

        rm -f ./Content/Translations/*.po

        # The ubuntu-24.04 system libopenmpt.so has undefined mpg123_*64 symbols but is underlinked (libmpg123
        # is not in its DT_NEEDED), so the final link fails. Explicitly link libmpg123 (installed below) after all
        # target libraries via CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES, which appends it at the end of every link line so it
        # resolves libopenmpt's references regardless of --as-needed.
        extraArgs=""
        if [ "${{ matrix.Backend }}" = "SDL3" ]; then extraArgs="-D CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES=-lmpg123"; fi

        # `DEATH_DEBUG_SYMBOLS` replaces `NCINE_STRIP_BINARIES` here: instead of discarding the debug info it
        # splits it off into "jazz2.pdb" and links the stripped executable back to it, the same way as on
        # Windows. The shipped executable stays just as small, but crash reports have function names again.
        cmake -B ./_build/ -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.BuildType }} -D DEATH_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=ON -D NCINE_PREFERRED_BACKEND=${{ matrix.Backend }} -D NCINE_PREFERRED_RHI=${{ matrix.RHI }} $extraArgs -D NCINE_ASSEMBLE_DEB=ON -D NCINE_ASSEMBLE_RPM=ON -D NCINE_WITH_GLEW=OFF -D NCINE_BUILD_ASSET_PACKER=${{ matrix.OfflineTools || 'OFF' }} -D NCINE_BUILD_SHADER_COMPILER=${{ matrix.OfflineTools || 'OFF' }}

    - name: 'Build'
      run: |
        make -j $(nproc) -C ./_build/

    - name: 'Create Package'
      run: |
        make package -C ./_build/
        mkdir ./_package/
        cp -f ./_build/jazz2 ./_package/jazz2
        # The split debug symbols, referenced by name from the executable's ".gnu_debuglink" section, so this
        # has to stay next to it and keep its file name
        cp -f ./_build/jazz2.pdb ./_package/jazz2.pdb
        cp -f ./_build/*.deb ./_package/jazz2.deb
        cp -f ./_build/*.rpm ./_package/jazz2.rpm
        cp -f -r ./Content/ ./_package/Content/
        cp -f ./LICENSE ./_package/LICENSE
        
        # Keep the OpenGL artifact names backward-compatible - only non-OpenGL rendering backends are suffixed
        rhiSuffix=""
        if [ "${{ matrix.RHI }}" != "OpenGL" ]; then rhiSuffix="_${{ matrix.RHI }}"; fi
        case "${{ matrix.CC }}" in
          gcc ) artifactPath="Jazz2_Linux_${{ matrix.Platform }}_${{ matrix.Backend }}${rhiSuffix}" ;;
          clang ) artifactPath="Jazz2_Linux_${{ matrix.Platform }}_${{ matrix.Backend }}${rhiSuffix}_Clang" ;;
          * ) artifactPath="Jazz2_Linux_${{ matrix.Platform }}_${{ matrix.Backend }}${rhiSuffix}_${{ matrix.CC }}" ;;
        esac
        echo "artifactPath=$artifactPath" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: 'Upload Package'
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: ${{ env.artifactPath }}
        path: ./_package/

    # `AssetPacker` converts the original game data ahead of time, it's a standalone tool that doesn't belong
    # in the game package, so it's published as its own artifact. Only the GCC entry publishes it - the Clang
    # one builds it just to keep the tool compiling on both compilers, and the two binaries would be
    # interchangeable anyway. `ShaderCompiler` is not published, it only regenerates sources that are already
    # committed to the repository.
    - name: 'Create Package (AssetPacker)'
      if: matrix.OfflineTools == 'ON' && matrix.CC == 'gcc'
      run: |
        mkdir ./_package_tools/
        cp -f ./_build/Utilities/AssetPacker/AssetPacker ./_package_tools/AssetPacker
        cp -f ./LICENSE ./_package_tools/LICENSE

    - name: 'Upload Package (AssetPacker)'
      if: matrix.OfflineTools == 'ON' && matrix.CC == 'gcc'
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: AssetPacker_Linux_${{ matrix.Platform }}
        path: ./_package_tools/

  Build-AppImage:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: GLFW
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: Vulkan
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++

    #runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
    runs-on: 'ubuntu-22.04'

    steps:
    - name: 'Checkout Repository'
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Cache apt packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          /var/cache/apt/archives
          /var/lib/apt/lists
        key: apt-ubuntu-22.04-v1
        restore-keys: |
          apt-ubuntu-22.04-

    - name: 'Create Build Environment'
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update -y
        # See the comment on `libdw-dev` in the `Build` job above
        sudo apt-get install -y cmake curl g++ libgl1-mesa-dev libglew2.2 libglfw3 libsdl2-2.0-0 libopenal1 libvorbisfile3 libopenmpt-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libdw-dev fuse

    - name: 'Configure CMake'
      run: |
        export CC=${{ matrix.CC }}
        export CXX=${{ matrix.CXX }}

        rm -f ./Content/Translations/*.po

        # See the comment on `DEATH_DEBUG_SYMBOLS` in the `Build` job above
        cmake -B ./_build/ -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.BuildType }} -D DEATH_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=ON -D NCINE_PREFERRED_BACKEND=${{ matrix.Backend }} -D NCINE_PREFERRED_RHI=${{ matrix.RHI }} -D NCINE_WITH_GLEW=OFF -D NCINE_LINUX_PACKAGE=jazz2 -D NCINE_PACKAGED_CONTENT_PATH=ON -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -D NCINE_BUILD_ASSET_PACKER=OFF -D NCINE_BUILD_SHADER_COMPILER=OFF

    - name: 'Build'
      run: |
        DESTDIR=../_appdir/ make install -j $(nproc) -C ./_build/

    - name: 'Create AppImage'
      run: |
        # Continuous releases briefly return 404 while their assets are being re-uploaded
        download() {
          for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            curl -f -s -S -O --location "$1" && return 0
            sleep 30
          done
          return 1
        }

        if [ ! -f linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage ]; then
          download 'https://github.com/darealshinji/linuxdeploy-plugin-checkrt/releases/download/continuous/linuxdeploy-plugin-checkrt.sh'
          download 'https://github.com/linuxdeploy/linuxdeploy/releases/download/continuous/linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage'
          chmod a+x linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage linuxdeploy-plugin-checkrt.sh
        fi
        
        mv -f ./_appdir/usr/share/jazz2/Content/ ./_appdir/usr/bin/Content/
        rm -f -r ./_appdir/usr/share/jazz2/
        rm -f -r ./_appdir/usr/share/doc/
        
        # elfutils' libdw is loaded with `dlopen()` rather than linked, so there is no DT_NEEDED entry for
        # linuxdeploy to pick up and it has to be named explicitly. It is worth bundling: linuxdeploy patches
        # the executable's RUNPATH to "$ORIGIN/../lib", which `dlopen()` honours for a bare SONAME, so the
        # crash reports stay symbolized even on a host that has no elfutils installed.
        libdwArgs=""
        libdwPath="$(ls /usr/lib/*/libdw.so.1 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
        if [ -n "$libdwPath" ]; then libdwArgs="--library=$libdwPath"; fi

        # `NO_STRIP` is required, linuxdeploy strips the deployed executable by default, which would remove the
        # ".gnu_debuglink" section pointing at the bundled "jazz2.pdb" and make the crash reports unreadable
        NO_STRIP=1 LDAI_OUTPUT="./_build/jazz2.AppImage" ARCH=x86_64 ./linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage $libdwArgs --appdir=./_appdir/ --icon-filename=jazz2 --desktop-file=./_appdir/usr/share/applications/jazz2.desktop --executable=./_appdir/usr/bin/jazz2 --custom-apprun=./Sources/AppRun --output=appimage --plugin checkrt

        rhiSuffix=""
        if [ "${{ matrix.RHI }}" != "OpenGL" ]; then rhiSuffix="_${{ matrix.RHI }}"; fi
        artifactPath="Jazz2_${{ matrix.Platform }}_${{ matrix.Backend }}${rhiSuffix}.AppImage"
        echo "artifactPath=$artifactPath" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        
    - name: 'Upload Package'
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: ${{ env.artifactPath }}
        path: ./_build/jazz2.AppImage
        
  CodeQL:
    name: 'CodeQL Analyze'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
    
    runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
    
    permissions:
      security-events: write

    steps:
    - name: 'Checkout Repository'
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Cache apt packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          /var/cache/apt/archives
          /var/lib/apt/lists
        key: apt-ubuntu-latest-v1
        restore-keys: |
          apt-ubuntu-latest-

    - name: 'Initialize CodeQL'
      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
      with:
        languages: cpp

    - name: 'Create Build Environment'
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update -y
        sudo apt-get install -y cmake curl g++ libgl1-mesa-dev libopenmpt-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev
    
    - name: 'Configure CMake and Build'
      run: |
        export CC=gcc
        export CXX=g++
        
        cmake -B ./_build/ -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D NCINE_WITH_GLEW=OFF
        make -j $(nproc) -C ./_build/
        
    - name: 'Perform CodeQL Analysis'
      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
",
  "rationale": "Added apt package caching to all three jobs (Build, Build-AppImage, CodeQL) using actions/cache@v4. This optimization reduces repeated dependency downloads on each workflow run, preserving all build and test coverage. The change is supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE which reports modest VM time reduction (6% free, 3.4% paid) from caching dependency downloads. Preconditions are met: repeated apt package fetching is measurable, and cache keys include the runner OS version to ensure compatibility. No permissions are weakened, no privileged actions added, and no new network access introduced beyond the existing cache service.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
